{{Top|fa}} {{Character |type=Corporate |image=[[File:Fillik-AcolyteVG.png]] |name=Fillik |homeworld=[[Kwenn]]''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' |birth=c. [[158 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' establishes that Fillik is twenty-six [[Standard year|years]] old during the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which take place in [[132 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TheAcolyteDate|here]]. Therefore, he must have been [[Reproduction|born]] around [[158 BBY]]. |death= |species=[[Human]] |gender= |pronouns=He/him |height=1.8 [[meter]]s {{C|6 [[Foot|feet]]}} |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Dark |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Trade Federation]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Osha! Why didn't you come out last night? You missed a wild trip to Nar Shaddaa with the piloting crew.''"
"''Oh yeah?''"
"''Yeah.''"
"''What I do with my days off is none of your business, Fillik.|Fillik, to Verosha Aniseya|audio=Fillik-Osha-NarShaddaa-LostFound.flac|{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}}} '''Fillik''' was a [[human]] who was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Kwenn]] around [[158 BBY]] and spent much of his [[Youngling|childhood]] around [[Kwenn Space Station]]. Not wanting to be influenced by [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]]s, he became a [[meknek]] and came to work on the [[Trade Federation]] [[WD-2550 Whydah-class Yield Conveyer|WD-2550 ''Whydah''-class yield conveyer]] ''[[Fallon]]'' during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]], he went for a [[Standard day|night]] out on the [[moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa]] and chided fellow meknek [[Verosha Aniseya]] for not attending the next day. The pair then worked together on repairing the [[Deflector shield generator|shield generator]] of the ''Fallon'' on the [[hull]] of the [[starship]] while it was in [[Realspace|space]]. As the pair worked, the ship's [[captain]], [[Blex]], called the mekneks disposable over [[Comlink|comms]] without realizing they could hear him. After Aniseya responded, Fillik pointed out the issue with the generator and Aniseya began welding it, but this caused the pressure gauge that Fillik was watching to spike and resulted in a small explosion at the pressure valve nearby. Aniseya then dealt with the [[Fire|flames]] from the explosion before a [[Jedi Vector]] approached the ''Fallon'', circling to dock as Fillik and Aniseya watched. ==Biography== ===A path away from Hutt Space=== [[File:MeknekTattoo-AcoylteVG.svg|thumb|right|220px|alt=Two mirrored [[Color|black]] rhomboids angled up.|Fillik and Verosha Aniseya got matching tattoos on Etti IV.]] Fillik was a [[human]] [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]]''[[The Living Force]]'' [[Kwenn]] on the edge of [[Hutt Space]] around [[158 BBY]]. He spent much of his [[Youngling|childhood]] in orbital [[Realspace|space]] around [[Kwenn Space Station]], giving him experience in [[Gravity|microgravity]] environments. Not wanting his future dictated by a fickle [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]], Fillik took one of the only avenues a human from near Hutt Space could take to advance beyond a lower-class lifestyle and parlayed his technical skills to become a [[meknek]] and travel beyond the confines of the region. By the [[time]] he was twenty-six in [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} Fillik had begun working with fellow meknek [[Verosha Aniseya]], and after a rowdy night on the [[Corporate Sector]] planet''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' [[Etti IV]], the pair got matching [[tattoo]]s. The tattoo consisted of two mirrored [[Color|black]] rhomboids with an upward angle symbolizing EV activity, but Fillik kept its location a secret along with his first name. ===A night on Nar Shaddaa=== {{Quote|What's the emergency?''"
"''Shield generator repairs.''"
"''Trade Feds never use the shields.''"
"''Maybe that's why they need it repaired.|Verosha Aniseya and Fillik|audio=Fillik-Osha-Emergency-LostFound.flac|}} [[File:Fillik-Neimoidians-LostFound.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=|Fillik and Verosha Aniseya stand against the wall of one of the ''Fallon's'' corridors to allow a pair of uniformed Neimoidians to pass.|Fillik and Verosha Aniseya worked on the Trade Federation vessel ''Fallon''.]] In 132 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], during the [[High Republic Era]], Fillik and Aniseya were working on the [[Trade Federation]] [[WD-2550 Whydah-class Yield Conveyer|WD-2550 ''Whydah''-class yield conveyer]] named the ''[[Fallon]]''. He accompanied the [[Starship|ship's]] [[pilot]]ing crew on a wild [[Local day|night]] out to [[Nar Shaddaa]], a [[moon]] in Hutt Space.''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Cookbook]]'' The following [[Standard day|day]], Fillik encountered Aniseya in the corridors of the ''Fallon'' after an alarm sounded signaling there was a job for the mekneks. He chided her for not joining the night out, but she refused to reveal what she had been doing instead. The pair's conversation was interrupted when they had to step out of the way of a pair of [[Neimoidian]]s who passed by them brusquely, after which Fillik informed Aniseya that the job for them was repairing the ship's [[Deflector shield generator|shield generators]]. Surprised, Aniseya pointed out that the Trade Federation rarely used the ship's [[Deflector shield|shields]], which Fillik countered might be the reason that the generator needed repairs. ===Outer repairs=== {{Quote|The emitter duct isn't connected to the field projector.''"
"''Yep, I see it.|Fillik and Verosha Aniseya|audio=Fillik-Osha-EmitterDuct-LostFound.flac|}} Despite [[Galactic Republic]] legislation stating that only [[droid]]s could carry out outer ship repairs, Fillik and Aniseya donned [[Environment suit|spacesuits]] with [[Magnetic grip boot|magnetic boots]]{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} {{AD|Disney+}} and exited the ship while it was in space via a small hatch onto the outer [[hull]]. They moved across the hull to the location of the shield generator and began their work on opposite sides, with Fillik pulling out his [[Fillik's PIP droid|PIP droid]]. As they worked, the ship's [[captain]], [[Blex]], began complaining on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] about the repairs not being completed and then claimed the mekneks were disposable, not realizing that Fillik and Aniseya could hear him over [[Comlink|comms]]. [[File:Fillik-SpaceSuit-LostFound.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Fillik and Verosha Aniseya, both wearing space suits, kneel around a protruding portion of the ''Falllon's'' exterior to carry out repairs.|Fillik and Verosha Aniseya donned suits to carry out repairs on the exterior of the ''Fallon''.]] Aniseya responded over comms, claiming to be hurt and joking that while Fillik was disposable, she was not. Smiling, Fillik shook his head and sarcastically called Aniseya funny, then pointed out that the [[emitter duct]] was not connected to the [[field projector]]. Spotting what Fillik had pointed out, Aniseya used her [[PIP droid]], [[Pip]], to begin welding the parts together. As she did so, Fillik grew concerned as the pressure gauge began to spike, but as he tried to warn Aniseya, the pressure valve exploded nearby, causing Fillik to shout. ===Fire and Jedi=== {{Quote|Friends of yours?|Fillik asks Verosha Aniseya about the Jedi|audio=Fillik-Friends-LostFound.flac|}} Sighing, Fillik explained the issue to Aniseya, who moved over to fix the valve, but momentarily froze upon seeing the [[fire]] from the explosion as she was haunted by a [[Mission to Brendok|memory]] from her childhood. As Pip snapped her out of the memory with a beep, Fillik complained that she should stop messing around, after which she put out the flames. [[File:Fillik-Jedi-LostFound.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Both wearing space suits, Fillik and Verosha Aniseya both stand on the exterior of the ''Fallon'' looking up at something out of frame.|Fillik and Verosha watched a Jedi Vector approach the ''Fallon''.]] As the flames subsided, a [[Jedi Vector]] approached the ''Fallon'', drawing Aniseya and Fillik's attention as it circled around to dock with the Trade Federation vessel. Watching it from the hull, Fillik asked if the new arrivals were Aniseya's friends, as she had previously been a member of the [[Jedi Order]]. After re-entering the ship, Aniseya was [[Mission to arrest Osha Aniseya|arrested]] by the [[Jedi]] and transferred onto the [[DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship]] ''[[Palwick]]'',{{Databank|palwick-prison-ship|Palwick prison ship}} as she was mistakenly believed to have committed a [[Indara's murder|murder]] in fact [[Mae's quest|carried out]] by her [[twin]] [[Aniseya family|sister]], [[Mae-ho Aniseya]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Dialogue|Blex|The grease grubbers are disposable. Our cargo is not.|Aniseya|You know, we can hear you…|Blex|[Groans]|Aniseya|And, uh, frankly, I'm hurt. Because, Fillik is clearly disposable, but me on the other hand, come on.|Fillik|Very funny.|line3=no|attr=A conversation between Blex and Verosha Aniseya that caused Fillik to smile|audio=Blex-Osha-Fillik-LostFound.flac|src=}} [[File:Fillik-LostFound.png|thumb|right|250px|alt=Fillik looks over his shoulder in the one of the corridors of the ''Fallon''.|Fillik chose was unfazed by the dangers of being a meknek, chosing the life to get away from Hutt influence.]] Fillik became a meknek to escape the influence of the Hutts on his [[homeworld]] and was unfazed by the inherent dangers of working as a meknek, instead reveling at the unique opportunity to see [[the galaxy]] that traveling onboard the ''Fallon'' presented.{{Databank|fillik|Fillik}} He found working in microgravity liberating and had no qualms working on the ship's exterior despite the dangerous conditions.{{Topps|set=2025 Topps Star Wars Chrome|cardname=#44 - Fillik|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/544247/cid/31223526/2025-Topps-Chrome-Star-Wars-44-Fillik}} Fillik chose to keep his first name and tattoo location secret, suggesting a hidden history. He did not coddle his PIP droid like Aniseya did hers and jokingly called her wicked and smiled when she later referred to him as disposable. However, when she froze upon seeing fire, he told her to stop messing around. Standing 1.8 [[meter]]s (six [[Foot|feet]]) tall, Fillik had dark skin, brown [[eye]]s, and black [[hair]], which he kept short to fit within his [[Meknek helmet|helmet]]. ==Skills and abilities== Fillik had technical skill and was experienced in working in microgravity environments. He spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard]]. ==Equipment== While on board the ''Fallon'', Fillik wore a green [[Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles]] [[unisuit workwear]] [[jumpsuit]] as a [[Clothing|uniform]] with black fingerless [[glove]]s and black electrically grounded work [[boot]]s. He kept his Pip unit in a side slung pocket that hung from a brown [[belt]]. While working in space, Fillik wore a dark red EVA suit with multilayered sealed gloves, a Pip unit [[holster]], and a reinforced and articulated layer beneath orange elastic cord cinch loops on the legs. His space gear also included white [[Magnetomic gription boot|magnatomic gription boot]]s and a white [[helmet]] attached to the suit with a pressure-retaining neck seal. The helmet had a pivoting actinic work lamp attached and a reinforced breathing hose that led to a white unit on Fillik's back that housed a vital [[gas]]ses status display indicator and a replaceable [[alga-scrubber convertor tube]]. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Repairs-AdamBrockbank-Instagram.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Concept art showing Fillik stood on the surface of the ''Fallon'' as Verosha Aniseya emerges from the ship.|Repairs, Adam Brockbank]] Fillik was portrayed by [[Anthony J. Abraham]] in "[[Lost / Found]]," the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired [[June 4]], [[2024]] on [[Disney+]].{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} The scenes on the ''Fallon'' were shot at [[Shinfield Studios]],{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}} [[Wikipedia:England|England]].{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}} Concept artist [[Ryan Church]] created at least two pieces of early concept art of the ship repair scene, with one showing three mekneks on the ship's surface rather then two and one drawn in [[2020]] showing two mekneks on the surface of a [[J-type diplomatic barge]].''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' Concept art of Fillik titled "Repairs" was created by [[Adam Brockbank]] under supervision of production designer [[Kevin Jenkins]].{{Instagram|username=brockbankadam|url=brockbankadam/p/C-XEKMxqwxz|name=[[Adam Brockbank]]|date=2024-08-07|quote=Repairs The Acolyte Production designer Kevin Jenkins|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/OMMRn|archivefile=File:AdamBrockbank-Repairs-Instagram.png}} The character's costume was designed by [[Jennifer Bryan]] and costume concepts drawn by [[Eleanor Barlow]] in [[2022]].{{ArtStation|subdomain=ebarlow|username=ebarlow|url=projects/0lY834|name=[[Eleanor Barlow]]|text=Osha + Fillick Illustrations for Acolyte, S1. Costume Design by Jennifer Bryan}} Concept costume illustrator [[James Casey-Holland]] also drew concept art of Fillik in his spacesuit. The 2024 [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry for Fillik lists his height as 1.78 meters, but the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], gives it as 1.8 meters (6 foot). This article assumes the newer source to be correct. ===Concept art galleries=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:TripleMeknekConcept-RyanChurch-ArtOfTheAcolyte.png|Early concept of cruiser maintenance, [[Ryan Church]] File:JTypeMeknekConcept-RyanChurch-ArtOfTheAcolyte.png|Early concept of cruiser maintenance, Ryan Church File:Repairs-AdamBrockbank-Instagram.jpg|Repairs, [[Adam Brockbank]] File:OshaFillik-CostumeConcept-Artstation.jpg|Costume concept, [[Eleanor Barlow]] File:FillikInSpaceSuit-JamesCasey-Holland-ArtOfTheAcolyte.png|Fillik in Space Suit, [[James Casey-Holland]] |digital= |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Fillik|imagecat=Images of Fillik}} *{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/the-acolyte/lost-found-episode-guide|text="Lost / Found" Episode Guide | The Acolyte}} *{{SWYouTube|DmI8K7Cz0jg|The Characters of The Acolyte | Now Streaming on Disney+}} {{Video}} *{{SW|url=news/dressing-the-acolyte-costumes-feature|text=Dressing ''The Acolyte'': The Stranger and an Assassin Hunt the Jedi of the High Republic — Updated}} {{Po}} *{{SWYouTube|DmI8K7Cz0jg|The Characters of The Acolyte | Now Streaming on Disney+}} {{Video}} *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' *{{Topps|set=2025 Topps Star Wars Chrome|cardname=#44 - Fillik|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/544247/cid/31223526/2025-Topps-Chrome-Star-Wars-44-Fillik}} *''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' *{{Databank|captain-blex|Captain Blex}} {{Imo}} *{{Databank|fillik|Fillik}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Fillik |fr=Fillik |ka=ფილიკი |nl=Fillik |pl=Fillik }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Mechanics]] [[Category:Trade Federation members]]
